title: Starlet scale to multipole response
note: Squared harmonic response W_j(l)^2 of each starlet scale, peak-normalised. Measured deterministically from single-pixel (white) inputs, so it carries no Monte Carlo error; cross-validated against 40 white-noise realisations (1.8% median agreement) and isotropic to 0.03%. Appendix material: it fixes the multipole band of each wavelet scale, which licenses the baryon-safe cut and the power-spectrum floor l >= 37. Method and interpretation: docs/starlet_scale_ell.md.
